'''R8-26''',<ref name="Card Trader">{{SWCT|set=Droids - 2024|cardname=R8-26}}</ref> '''R8''' for short, was an [[R-series]] [[astromech droid]] who served the [[New Republic]]<ref name="The Path of Hate" /> by [[5 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> specifically [[Ambassador]] [[Nadura]]. R8 joined Nadura on a mission to [[Corvus]], Nadura's [[homeworld]], where she hoped to accept them into the new government. R8 stayed with the [[Starship|ship]] while Nadura and her guards entered the [[city]] of [[Calodan]]. However, when the ruling [[magistrate]], [[Morgan Elsbeth]], refused and resorted to violence, Nadura fled, telling R8 to send a [[distress signal]]. Before R8 could get through to anyone, Elsbeth's guards blew up the ship, destroying R8 in the explosion.<ref name="The Path of Hate" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
R8 appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Empire]]'' episode "[[The Path of Anger]],"<ref name="The Path of Hate" /> released on [[May 4]], [[2024]].
